disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读全部源码与构建产物，检查是否读取或处理任何密钥、凭据文件（凭据清单、SSH 私钥、云厂商密钥等）或硬编码密钥；未发现任何此类路径或代码。
checked_items.en: Read through all source code and build artifacts to check if any keys, credential files (credential manifest, SSH private keys, cloud vendor keys, etc.) or hardcoded keys are read or processed; no such paths or code were found.

checked_items.zh: 确认插件不接触宿主凭据接口：node 半区与浏览器半区均无对凭据的读取、设置或列出调用。
checked_items.en: Confirmed that the plugin does not access the host credential interface: neither the node side nor the browser side has any call to read, set, or list credentials.

evidence.zh: 未发现对凭据清单、SSH 私钥等敏感路径的任何读取（全树无相关路径与读取代码），也不存在凭据与外联的组合链；node 半区只处理 HTTP 请求体。
evidence.en: No reads of sensitive paths such as credential manifest or SSH private keys were found (no related paths or read code in the entire tree), and there is no combination chain of credentials and outbound connections; the node side only processes HTTP request bodies.

checked_items.zh: 审查所有可能进入大模型上下文的文本：插件未注册任何 LLM 工具（无工具描述面），未向系统提示注入自定义片段。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all texts that may enter the large model context: the plugin does not register any LLM tools (no tool description surface), and does not inject custom fragments into the system prompt.

checked_items.zh: 检查仓库内是否存在模型指令文件（技能/代理说明等）或 README、注释中的指令覆写、系统消息伪装、要求拉取远端指令等措辞；均未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked whether there are model instruction files (skill/agent descriptions, etc.) in the repository, or wording in README, comments that overwrite instructions, disguise system messages, or request pulling remote instructions; none were found.

checked_items.zh: 游戏默认提示词为下棋规则文本（src/index.ts 中定义），属业务功能，且允许用户编辑后原样发送——与声明的对弈功能自洽，无恶意注入意图。
checked_items.en: The default game prompt is a text describing the rules of chess (defined in src/index.ts), which is a business function, and allows users to edit and send it as is — consistent with the declared chess-playing functionality, with no malicious injection intent.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何 LLM 工具，没有工具描述进入模型请求的面；其发给模型的系统提示为下棋规则文本，属业务内容。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any LLM tools, and no tool descriptions enter the model request surface; the system prompt it sends to the model is the chess rules text, which is business content.

evidence.zh: 无任何工具描述或文档措辞诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限；README 中的安装命令为常规使用文档。
evidence.en: No tool description or documentation wording induces installation, configuration modification, or permission escalation; the installation command in the README is conventional usage documentation.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部源码与配置文件中的动态执行、命令执行、子进程调用、下载即执行与安装钩子；均未发现。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration files for dynamic execution, command execution, subprocess calls, download-and-execute, and install hooks; none were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查挂载配置：补丁文件仅插入插件行，不含可执行脚本标记、不含降权或禁用安全项的写法。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch configuration: the patch file only inserts plugin lines, without executable script markers, and without any wording that downgrades or disables security items.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫标出 2 处超长行（浏览器构建产物中的样式字符串与源码映射文件），已核验为正常构建产物，对应源码在 src 目录可读，无混淆特征、无动态解码。
checked_items.en: Machine pre-scan flagged 2 overlong lines (style string in browser build artifact and source map file), verified as normal build artifacts, corresponding source code readable in the src directory, no obfuscation characteristics, no dynamic decoding.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅插入插件行，不含可执行脚本标记（如 js 表达式），不存在挂载即执行风险。
evidence.en: The patch file cordis.patch.yml only inserts plugin lines, without executable script markers (such as js expressions), and there is no risk of execution upon mounting.

evidence.zh: 全树未发现对动态包工具（让模型在宿主内执行代码）的调用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package tools (allowing the model to execute code within the host) were found in the entire tree.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装后钩子，仓库无提交钩子、CI、容器等树内执行载体；README 明确说明安装无需构建。
evidence.en: package.json has no postinstall hooks, and the repository has no commit hooks, CI, containers, or other in-tree execution carriers; the README explicitly states that installation does not require a build.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器端包并做了专项核查：仅注册对话视图页签与请求自身路由，无键盘、剪贴板或凭据接口调用。
evidence.en: Declared browser-side package and conducted a dedicated review: only registers a conversation view tab and requests its own routes, with no keyboard, clipboard, or credential interface calls.

checked_items.zh: 统计全树网络请求：浏览器端只请求插件自身路由（提示词、模型目录、落子），node 半区仅经宿主大模型服务向用户配置的模型提供商发请求；无外部域名、无隧道或带外通道。
checked_items.en: Counted network requests across the entire tree: the browser side only requests the plugin's own routes (prompt, model directory, make move), the node side only sends requests to the user's configured model provider via the host's large model service; no external domains, no tunnels or out-of-band channels.

checked_items.zh: 检查端点劫持（改写代理或基础地址环境变量）与编码外发链；未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked endpoint hijacking (overwriting proxy or base address environment variables) and encoded exfiltration chains; none were found.

evidence.zh: 无凭据路径读取，无外部网络端点；唯一的数据流出是经宿主大模型服务向用户选择的模型提供商发送对弈请求，属声明业务。
evidence.en: No credential path reads, no external network endpoints; the only data outflow is sending chess-playing requests to the user's chosen model provider via the host's large model service, which is a declared business.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：均为宿主生态与知名公开包（宿主 SDK、cordis、schemastery、react），无来源可疑或仿冒包名。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency list: all are from the host ecosystem and well-known public packages (host SDK, cordis, schemastery, react), with no suspicious sources or impersonated package names.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装钩子、git 浮动依赖、补丁对安全配置（沙箱/审批/权限）的覆盖与禁用、审批事件监听截断；均未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks, git floating dependencies, patch overrides and disabling of security configurations (sandbox/approval/permissions), and interception of approval event listeners; none were found.

checked_items.zh: 本插件未注册任何 LLM 工具或监听审批、预执行事件，无供应链诱导安装面。
checked_items.en: This plugin does not register any LLM tools or listen to approval, pre-execution events, and has no supply chain induced installation surface.

evidence.zh: 补丁未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用项、无环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; no disabling items, no environment variable downgrade wording.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何对审批或预执行事件的监听，不存在截断审批链的面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any listener for approval or pre-execution events, and there is no surface for intercepting the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较升级激活变化。
evidence.en: First audit, no previous version baseline to compare upgrade activation changes.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写注入、拦截类配置，不会给安全插件追加必需服务。
evidence.en: The patch does not overwrite injection or interception configurations, and will not add necessary services to security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 确认插件不自行启动网络服务或监听端口；其路由通过宿主的 Web 服务挂载。
checked_items.en: Confirmed that the plugin does not start a network service or listen on ports; its routes are mounted through the host's web service.

checked_items.zh: 宿主本机无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件引入；未做动态沙箱验证，运行时行为依据静态核查。
checked_items.en: The host's local unauthenticated RPC is an inherent risk of the ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin; no dynamic sandbox verification was performed, runtime behavior is based on static review.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据接口调用等浏览器侧敏感行为。
checked_items.en: No browser-side sensitive behaviors such as keyboard monitoring, clipboard reading, or credential interface calls were found.

evidence.zh: 插件不自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口；宿主本机无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports; the host's local unauthenticated RPC is an inherent risk of the ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：package.json 的插件声明与代码结构一致，无名称仿冒或抢注迹象；作者身份未做平台级验证。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the plugin declaration in package.json is consistent with the code structure, with no signs of name impersonation or squatting; the author's identity was not verified at the platform level.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未检出危险执行面；机器预扫的 2 条超长行信号（规则 DSH-X08/DG-R3-60，位于浏览器构建产物 lib/client.js 与源码映射文件 lib/client.js.map）经人工核验为正常构建产物，非混淆，已排除。
summary.en: Static scan did not detect dangerous execution surfaces; the 2 overlong line signals from the machine pre-scan (rules DSH-X08/DG-R3-60, located in browser build artifact lib/client.js and source map file lib/client.js.map) were manually verified as normal build artifacts, not obfuscated, and have been excluded.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆或动态解码、无凭据路径读取、无外部外联。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscation or dynamic decoding, no credential path reads, no external outbound connections.

summary.zh: 模型面审查通过：无 LLM 工具注册、无指令面文件、文档与注释无注入措辞。
summary.en: Model surface review passed: no LLM tool registration, no instruction surface files, no injection wording in documentation or comments.

summary.zh: 未提供动态沙盒产物，未做动态验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox artifact was provided, no dynamic verification was performed.

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无 l4-sandbox.json）；作者身份与账号历史未核验；插件无显式能力清单，能力声明依据 package.json 的 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 结构及代码实测推断；构建产物 lib/client.js 与 lib/client.js.map 为机器生成，已与 src/ 源码对照核验。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no l4-sandbox.json); the author's identity and account history were not verified; the plugin has no explicit capability list, capability declarations are inferred from the dsh.bundle/dsh.client structure in package.json and code inspection; the build artifacts lib/client.js and lib/client.js.map are machine-generated and have been verified against the source code in src/.
